title: The Edge of Knowing
statement: A small Earth hangs in the dark beyond the reach of certainty. Around it, a city becomes an inference, a botanical plate and a witness insist on what can be recorded, while the fantastical Waq-waq image opens onto what cannot be verified. The collage keeps these modes adjacent but never reconciled: knowledge has edges, inference has scaffolding, and the unknown remains vivid.
brief:
Create an original collage using only the provided source images. There is no target image. Respond to the condition through the composition itself. Give the finished work a title and a short artist statement.

Represent the boundary between what you know, what you infer, and what you cannot know.
